S.PHON: nuu mupanaʔəku ʔinia ɾavai ia musutavərəkitaʔai
S.TRANSL: "When I shoot (the sun), friend, let's dive into the water," (he said).

S.FORM: si ʔaisi sian khiojiu=maku ʔaisi um-ala kaari=mita.
S.PHON: ʂi ʔaiʂi ʂian khiojiumaku ʔaiʂi umaɾa kaarimita
ʂi ʔaiʂi ʂian khiojiumaku ʔaiʂi uma[r|ɾ]a kaa[r|ɾ]imita
S.TRANSL: Because my professor is recording our words here.

S.FORM: iimu iikamu ia, t<um>imana-a kaari masi-kanakanavu.
S.PHON: iimu iikamu ia tumimanaa kaari maʂikanakanavu
S.FORM: iimu iikamu ia, t<um>imanaa kaari masikanakanavu.
S.PHON: iimu iikamu ia tumimanaa kaa[r|ɾ]i maʂikanakanavu
S.TRANSL: Therefore, you are to listen to words and learn to speak Kanakanavu.
They lent it to him, yet there was no rice.

S.FORM: masua=cu mipi-ta-pusa-n=ci s<əm>ərəcə ia, u-rucini=cu macuʔa sua tavənəvənə.
S.PHON: masuaʦu mipitapusantʂi səmərəʦə ia urutʂiniʦu maʦuʔa sua tavənəvənə
S.FORM: masuacu mipitapusanci s<em>erece ia, urucinicu macu'a sua tavenevene.
S.PHON: masuaʦu mipitapusantʂi seme[r|ɾ]eʦe ia u[r|ɾ]utʂiniʦu maʦuʔa sua tavenevene
S.TRANSL: The second time they went to check it, there were two bananas.

S.FORM: ala ʔinia mia-salai na salai-ini mu-caa ma-avici taanaasa.
S.PHON: aɾa ʔinia miasaɾai na saɾaiini muʦaa maavitʂi taanaasa
S.FORM: ara 'inia miasarai na saraiini mucaa maavici taanaasa.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]a ʔinia miasa[r|ɾ]ai na sa[r|ɾ]aiini muʦaa maavitʂi taanaasa
S.TRANSL: They put it into their pocket and brought it home.
If it rains, I won't go.
If he comes, please tell me.
How many children do you have?

S.FORM: pu-aiʔ-a taanaasa ʔakun ki-paapa kimia n<um>a-namarə si ta-tiʔiŋ=pa=kasu mata ma-nanakə=kasu.
S.PHON: puaiʔa taanaasa ʔakun kipaapa kimia numanamarə ʂi tatiʔiŋpakasu mata mananakəkasu
S.FORM: puai'a taanaasa 'akun kipaapa kimia n<um>anamare si tati'ingpakasu mata mananakekasu.
S.PHON: puaiʔa taanaasa ʔakun kipaapa kimia numanama[r|ɾ]e ʂi tatiʔiŋpakasu mata mananakekasu
S.TRANSL: Go home! Don't follow us as we go to burn the bush because you're still too young and you're a girl."

S.FORM: sua iiku ia, kaʔan=ku pə-rəsəəvə ma-manəŋ.
S.PHON: sua iiku ia kaʔanku pərəsəəvə mamanəŋ
S.FORM: sua iiku ia, ka'anku pereseeve mamaneng.
S.PHON: sua iiku ia kaʔanku pe[r|ɾ]eseeve mamaneŋ
S.TRANSL: As for me, it is best that I should not tell a lie.
The place of drawing water is where I killed a pig.

FORM.notes: Source judgment resolved under POL-016/POL-017; exact source and exclusion are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.TRANSL: 'What did he use to cook rice?'

FORM.notes: Source judgment resolved under POL-016/POL-017; exact source and exclusion are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: tia=pa pu-aiʔi nacəŋa si ʔaisi=pa ʔinia kaən-a-ini aʔun-ai ʔinia.
S.PHON: tiapa puaiʔi naʦəŋa ʂi ʔaiʂipa ʔinia kaənaini aʔunai ʔinia
S.FORM: tiapa puai'i nacenga si 'aisipa 'inia kaenaini a'unai 'inia.
S.PHON: tiapa puaiʔi naʦeŋa ʂi ʔaiʂipa ʔinia kaenaini aʔunai ʔinia
S.TRANSL: (People) returned to Nacenga because some food had been left there and they wanted to carry it (on back to the new home).

S.FORM: sua mia-iisua ʔaisi ava t<um>a-timana nanala ʔusu tia=nummana sa-saruanai ʔ<um>a-ʔanupu mata n<um>a-namarə.
S.PHON: sua miaiisua ʔaiʂi ava tumatimana nanaɾa ʔusu tianummana sasaruanai ʔumaʔanupu mata numanamarə
S.FORM: sua miaiisua 'aisi ava t<um>atimana nanara 'usu tianummana sasaruanai '<um>a'anupu mata n<um>anamare.
S.PHON: sua miaiisua ʔaiʂi ava tumatimana nana[r|ɾ]a ʔusu tianummana sasa[r|ɾ]uanai ʔumaʔanupu mata numanama[r|ɾ]e
S.TRANSL: At that time the orphan 'Usu in fact heard when the men would go hunting and burn a bush.
I am tying up these pieces of wood.
I feel bad that I cannot see very well.
I'm too old to be able to work.

S.FORM: nuu ni-ari-sina-n=ci ia, pu-ʔucip-ini=cu na ʔuia.
S.PHON: nuu niariʂinantʂi ia puʔutʂipiniʦu na ʔuia
nuu nia[r|ɾ]iʂinantʂi ia puʔutʂipiniʦu na ʔuia
S.TRANSL: When it has been washed, we cook it in an iron pot.

S.FORM: koo=kani paki-sapatə sua vali-ini, panaʔ-ai=kani sa caraʔə taniarə, ni-macai ʔinia.
S.PHON: kookani pakisapatə sua vaɾiini panaʔaikani sa ʦaraʔə taniarə nimaʦai ʔinia
S.FORM: kookani pakisapate sua variini, pana'aikani sa cara'e taniare, nimacai 'inia.
S.PHON: kookani pakisapate sua va[r|ɾ]iini panaʔaikani sa ʦa[r|ɾ]aʔe tania[r|ɾ]e nimaʦai ʔinia
S.TRANSL: His friend could not make it, he was shot by the blood of the sun, and he died.
They could not eat without fire.
